The global brand color automatically generates all button, progress, and accent tones (light / dark).
Appearance packs, glass/surface tokens, icons, and trust badges are managed here.
Global brand color
Pick one color — buttons, progress, focus rings, and soft background tones are generated automatically.
Brand color
What it does: This is your site’s main identity color. When you save, Add to cart / Go to checkout / popup trigger / progress fill / success-screen accents update automatically from the light–dark palette generated from this color. If the “Primary” field on the product card is filled, it overrides the brand color for that product.

Appearance packs
Click a pack — colors, radius, and density fill the form fields. They apply on the site after you save.
Ocean Classic
Default ocean blue (#0f608b), 12px radius, balanced surface.
Soft Glass
Glass panel, strong blur, airy sky blue, 16px radius.
Sharp Trust
Corporate navy, tight typography, 8px radius.
Horizon
Vivid sky blue, soft accent, emotional headline.
Export current appearance
Import pack
Apply pack now & save
Clicking a card: Only fills the form fields (does not save yet). “Apply pack now & save”: Writes the selected pack to the database; updates Regular / Share-based / Progress / Success colors; the page does not reload. Export: Downloads current settings as JSON. Import: Loads a JSON pack and applies it.
Surface & typography
Glass panel, elevation, and form density — the real glass tokens for the Soft Glass pack live here.
Form density (global)
Compact
Normal
Spacious
What it does: Sets inner form spacing (line height, field gaps, padding). Compact = less scrolling; Spacious = more comfortable touch use. If “Density” is set on the product card, that product overrides this setting.
Glass blur (px)
What it does: The “frosted glass” blur strength of the popup background. #N# = no blur (flat panel). Higher values = softer and heavier (performance cost may increase). Visual effect may be limited because the popup background is currently forced to flat white; it is meaningful together with Soft Glass packs.
Glass fill opacity (%)
What it does: How opaque or transparent the popup surface is. #N# = fully opaque white; #N#–#N# = a glass effect where the page behind shows through slightly. #N#+ is recommended for readability.
Elevation (#N#–#N#)
What it does: Popup and card shadow depth. #N# = flat/minimal; #N# = a clearly raised shadow. Sets the “floating” feel without changing the brand hue.
Overlay color
What it does: The dimmer color that darkens the background when the popup opens. Usually a dark navy/black; a dark tone close to the brand also works.
Overlay opacity (%)
What it does: How dark the dimmer is. Low = the background stays readable; high = more focus on the form, darker background. Typical range #N#–#N#.
Form font stack
What it does: The typeface family inside the popup/form. “inherit” = use your theme’s font. For a custom font, write a CSS font-family (not a Google Fonts URL). E.g. 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif — the font must already be loaded in the theme or on the page.
Motion
Subtle
Normal
Expressive
What it does: Sets the strength of animations such as open, success, and progress celebration. Subtle = calmer sites; Expressive = livelier transitions. Animations are already reduced for users with “prefers-reduced-motion” on.
Quick amount button style
Soft
Outline
Solid
What it does: How quick amount options (#N# / #N# / #N#…) look. Soft = light fill; Outline = border only; Solid = a button filled with the brand color. If quick amount buttons are off (product/general setting), this setting is hidden.
Icons
Pick from the built-in SVG set or upload your own icon from the Media Library.
Field icons
Icons on the name, note, and email rows
What it does: Turns the small icons to the left of form rows on or off. When off, the fields look simpler. A Use general / On / Off choice on the product card overrides this per product.
Full name icon
Left icon on the full name row.
Select from media
Reset
Note icon
Icon for the note / message field.
Select from media
Reset
Email icon
Icon used when the email row is on.
Select from media
Reset
Phone icon
Fallback/custom icon for the phone row (can be used next to the country picker).
Select from media
Reset
Add to cart icon
Icon on the “Add to cart” CTA button.
Select from media
Reset
Go to checkout icon
Icon on the “Go to checkout” CTA button.
Select from media
Reset
Trust strip icon
Left icon of the trust text under the buttons.
Select from media
Reset
Continue icon
Icon for the “Continue” step button on a multi-step (wizard) form.
Select from media
Reset
Success icon
Confirmation icon on the success / thank-you screen.
Select from media
Reset
Extra donation icon
Title/icon area of the extra donation (sadaqah) block.
Select from media
Reset
Progress icon
Decorative / badge icon fallback on progress forms.
Select from media
Reset
Icon picker: Click a built-in SVG icon or upload your own image with “Select from media” (small PNG/SVG recommended). “Reset” returns to the first built-in icon. Changes become permanent with “Save settings”.
Trust strip
Show trust text under the CTA
What it does: Shows the “Secure payment…” line right under the Add to cart / Go to checkout buttons. If JSON badges are filled, they may take priority; if this key is off, the strip is fully hidden.
Trust text (single-badge fallback)
What it does: Single-line trust message shown when JSON trust badges are empty. Keep it short (max #N# characters) so it stays readable under the mobile CTA.
Content modules (global default)
These defaults are used when the product card is off.
Email field
Show email on the regular form
What it does: Asks the donor for an email. When on, an extra row appears on the form. If “Email field” is off on the product card, it is hidden for that product. Not shown on share-based forms.
Dedication field
Dedication field
What it does: Collects a dedication such as “On behalf of?”; it is written to order meta. Useful for memorial / gift donations. Not shown on share-based forms.
Anonymous donation
Anonymous donation
If checked, the donor name is hidden on public lists; it remains visible on order records.
Dedication placeholder
What it does: Sample text shown when the dedication field is empty. Tells the user what to write; it is not a required value.
Privacy notice link
Show privacy notice link
The privacy notice must live on your site’s personal-data/privacy page; only the link is shown here. It appears only when the form has at least one of the email, dedication, or shareholder fields (off by default).
Link label
Short label shown on the link. If left empty, the default label is used.
Link URL
If the URL is empty and there is also no WordPress Privacy Policy page, the link is not shown on the form. Select a page under Settings → Privacy or enter a URL here.
Default module order
What it does: Order of the #N# heading blocks in the popup header (comma-separated). E.g. media,impact,urgency,social_proof,progress. Unknown IDs are ignored. The form body is fixed: donor → dedication → amount → processing fee. If “Module order” is set on the product card, the product wins. If left empty, the default order is used.
Trust badges (JSON, max #N#)
What it does: Shows more than one trust badge under the form. JSON array format: [{"icon":"builtin:shield","text":"SSL"},{"icon":"builtin:heart","text":"Secure"}]. Maximum #N# badges. If empty, the single-line “Trust text” below is used as a fallback. Invalid JSON is not saved / treated as empty.
Save settings
LIVE PREVIEW
Pack and surface settings apply on the front end after you save. Product overrides come from the product card.
